description: Contextual list of actions, separators and labels, with keyboard navigation; no nested submenus.

howToUse: Use it for actions about one thing that do not fit on screen: the "more" of a row, of a card or of a header.
Write each item as a verb ("Rename", "Duplicate"), separate groups with a separator, and leave the action that deletes for last.
Open it from an IconButton or Button and handle the choice in `onSelect`.
It has one level only: no submenus.
alternatives: Choosing a value for a form: Select or Combobox.

keyboard.action: Goes to the first or last item.
Goes to the next item that starts with it.
